body:
Source: the release review of v1.11.1..main. Re-verified on claude-review. Defects, as facts at that base:
(a) packages/autopilot/lib/round.mjs guards a missing run record only at round() entry; every later ctx.records.update (after the fleet dispatch, the fast-forward, completion, review, attest, push and PR upsert, and inside block()/mismatch()) throws "no run record for issue N" when the record is retired while the step awaits, replacing the step's result with a rejection. packages/autopilot/lib/ci.mjs watchCi dereferences record.issue on a null record and writes the record bare after every await. packages/autopilot/lib/run.mjs runIssue tolerates a vanished record at the ticketCache write but continues into the signed ticket write, the coldstart and the mirror build. Tracked in #1001.
(b) packages/autopilot/lib/gates.mjs runOuterGates defaults its sandbox backend to a host PATH probe; the sequence fixture pins bwrap to a fake path, so AC21/AC25/AC28/AC30/AC36/AC38/AC44/AC46/AC50/AC108/AC140/AC144 fail with sandbox-unavailable on any host without bubblewrap.
(c) packages/autopilot/test/helpers/gates-ctx.mjs spawns git with GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null and pins gc.auto only on the root repository, so the mirrors and clones production creates under the fixture root run with auto-gc enabled while tests recursively delete the root.
(d) packages/autopilot/lib/github.mjs ensureComment/hasComment treat any comment containing an adlc-autopilot sentinel as already posted, by any author, and posted bodies embed model/reviewer/CI text with "<!--" intact, so one comment can suppress a different terminal comment.
(e) packages/autopilot/test/status.test.mjs AC87 gives a spawned holder 60 ms to take the mutex, and requires a child writer to have waited >= 500 ms measured after its own startup; both fail when node startup is slow (#1002, #1040).
(f) packages/autopilot/lib/lock.mjs and packages/fleet/lib/lock.mjs reclaim a stale lock by renaming whatever is at the lock path and deleting it, without checking the moved directory is the one judged stale; a second reclaimer deletes the first one's fresh lock.
(g) packages/fleet/lib/quartermaster.mjs planSeats discards readManifestForest's skipped list, so fleet dry-run/live routing on partial ledger evidence gives no signal.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. packages/autopilot: lib/records.mjs (run-record store), lib/round.mjs (round/attestTail/pushAndOpen/block/mismatch), lib/ci.mjs (watchCi), lib/run.mjs (runIssue/continueRun/settleCi), lib/github.mjs + lib/effects.mjs (comments/labels), lib/lock.mjs. packages/fleet: lib/lock.mjs, lib/quartermaster.mjs, bin/fleet.mjs. Tests: `npm test -w packages/autopilot`, `npm test -w packages/fleet`. Fixtures: test/helpers/sequence-fixture.mjs (production context via buildContext overrides), test/helpers/gates-ctx.mjs, test/helpers/triage-gh.mjs, test/helpers/signal.mjs (causal latches). run-init-failure.test.mjs, github.test.mjs and status.test.mjs pin behaviour this ticket changes and may be edited.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. One exported helper records.updateIfPresent(records, issue, patch) returns the updated record, null for a vanished record, and rethrows any other write failure (decided by reloading, never by message). Every post-await record write in round.mjs, ci.mjs and run.mjs uses it. A write that precedes further world-effects stops the run with { state: 'unchanged', reason: 'record-vanished' } (watchCi: { outcome: 'record-vanished' }, mapped by settleCi); a write that only records an outcome already decided (blocked, oid-mismatch, quota-paused, unchanged, done, re-evaluation) is tolerated and terminal effects are skipped without a record. runIssue stops right after staged creation when the record is gone.
2. The sequence fixture supplies the sandbox backend its fake bwrap stands for through buildContext's module override; production is unchanged. Real-bwrap tests keep their loud host skip.
3. The gates-ctx fixture's git env carries gc.auto=0 and gc.autoDetach=false as command-scope config (GIT_CONFIG_COUNT/KEY_n/VALUE_n); GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL stays /dev/null.
4. github.commentBody(sentinel, body) neutralises every "<!--" in body; every sentinel post goes through it. hasComment/ensureComment take { author } and count a sentinel only in a comment by that login; the terminal effects, digest and pr-closed notice pass ctx.remote.principal (no author: any comment counts, as before).
5. AC87 awaits child output lines (held / writing) and a release file instead of timers, and still fails under status.quotaOutsideMutex and status.noFileMutex.
6. Both lock reclaims compare the quarantined owner with the owner judged stale (autopilot: token; fleet: full owner metadata) and on a mismatch rename it back and refuse (autopilot LockHeldError naming the holder; fleet { acquired:false, refused:true }). fleet acquireLock takes an optional fs override (LOCK_FS).
7. planSeats returns skippedLedger and, when it is non-empty, appends skippedLedgerNotice to the notices fleet already prints to stderr in the dry-run and the live run. The --json stdout document is unchanged. Document in packages/fleet/README.md (the fleet.mdx mirror has no quartermaster section).

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 A record vanishing during dispatch, fast-forward, dependency checks, completion, review, attest, pre-push diff check, push, PR upsert or the CI watch never rejects and never runs a later world-effect; decided outcomes are still returned. verify: `node --test packages/autopilot/test/record-vanished-midflight.test.mjs`
- AC2 A full fake-bwrap fixture run completes with no sandbox backend on PATH. verify: `node --test packages/autopilot/test/sandbox-absent.test.mjs`
- AC3 Repositories production creates under the gates-ctx fixture see gc.auto=0 and gc.autoDetach=false. verify: `node --test packages/autopilot/test/gates-ctx-gc.test.mjs`
- AC4 A sentinel inside a body or in another author's comment cannot suppress a terminal comment. verify: `node --test packages/autopilot/test/comment-marker.test.mjs`
- AC5 AC87 passes with a 400 ms startup delay preloaded into every node process. verify: `node --test packages/autopilot/test/status.test.mjs`
- AC6 A late reclaimer never deletes the winner's lock (autopilot and fleet). verify: `node --test packages/autopilot/test/lock-reclaim-race.test.mjs packages/fleet/test/lock-reclaim-race.test.mjs`
- AC7 Skipped ledger lines are reported by planSeats and the notice. verify: `node --test packages/fleet/test/quartermaster-skipped-ledger.test.mjs`
- AC8 Existing suites green. verify: `npm test -w packages/autopilot && npm test -w packages/fleet`
- AC9 README documents the ledger warning. verify: `grep -c "malformed ledger line" packages/fleet/README.md` (>= 1)
- AC10 Mutation gate green on the branch. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0

OUT OF SCOPE: installing bubblewrap in CI workflows or a workflow guard for it; revalidation-failure retireRun with a null record; the fleet lock's two-step (mkdir then owner write) publish; model-router's own skipped-ledger handling.
title: autopilot/fleet: stop vanished run records, forged sentinels and racing lock reclaims from breaking a run
